blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Finance Secretary Frederick Go has signed a P48-billion financing agreement with the Asian Development Bank (ADB) to fund the third phase of the Philippine government’s universal health care reform program. The financing, equivalent to 119.745 billion Japanese yen and first approved in August, will support the Build Universal Health Care Program Subprogram 3 […]...
